summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Diana Shipping Inc. announcing a routine time charter contract for its vessel m/v Medusa with Aquavita International S.A. at a gross rate of US$16,850 per day for a period from July 10, 2026 to between October 5, 2027 and December 20, 2027. This is an ordinary business contract in the shipping industry, not a special situation. No material corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is involved. The filing simply reports a commercial charter agreement with no change in control or special transaction.
